name: Ixidor
description: Cast the Nightmare spell that made Phage's deathwurms, and was devoured when his unmen betrayed him.

description_citations.text: "Wurm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor's dream magic sends the deathwurms out of Phage, leaving her Jeska again.
timeline.quote: those deathwurms were sent out into the world, leaving her once again Jeska

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The surviving wurm containing Nivea consumes Ixidor so he can rest with his love.
timeline.quote: that wurm consumed Ixidor, so he could rest with his love forever

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids is injured commanding Cabal forces, used by Akroma, then serves Stonebrow before escaping to rejoin the Cabal.
timeline.quote: She eventually managed to escape and rejoin the Cabal.

citation.text: "Braids", section "The capture of Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor imagines the ruin of enemies and Akroma makes it so.
timeline.quote: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

citation.text: Akroma's Vengeance (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ixidor declares reality has exiled him.
timeline.quote: Reality has exiled me. I am no longer bound by its laws.

citation.text: Ixidor, Reality Sculptor (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Heartbroken and abandoned in the desert over gambling debts, Ixidor shapes Akroma from his dream at the cost of his right arm, charging her to avenge Nivea.
timeline.quote: Ixidor gave her but one objective: to avenge Nivea, no matter the cost.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Angel of Wrath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor heals and enhances Akroma, dreaming a jaguar whose legs replace hers, making her a centaur-angel.
timeline.quote: Akroma's legs were replaced by those of the jaguar.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Angel of Wrath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Nightmare War Akroma leads Ixidor's creations against the Cabal and Krosans until Phage releases deathwurms; Nivea's soul swallows Ixidor.
timeline.quote: The last deathwurm, the soul of Nivea, sought out Ixidor, swallowed him, and escaped as Akroma watched helplessly.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl declares war on Ixidor and leads the Cabal and Krosan alliance against Topos in the Nightmare War, defeating his Mirari-possessed persona.
timeline.quote: Kamahl led the joint forces into battle

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor discovers his reality-sculpting powers and uses them to create the angel Akroma.
timeline.quote: Ixidor uses his new power to create the angel Akroma .

citation.text: "Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage kills Nivea in the pits and Ixidor, bankrupted by the loss, is left naked in the desert swearing revenge.
timeline.quote: Created out of Jeska, she has a putrefying touch and great battle mastery, and she easily subdues the duo, killing Nivea.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cabal strip Ixidor and abandon him in the desert after discovering his forged coins.
timeline.quote: The Cabal officers knock him out and leave him naked in the desert, where he swears revenge upon Phage.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor discovers his illusion powers and builds the kingdom of Topos.
timeline.quote: Soon he built his kingdom, known as Topos

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor dreams Phage has come for him and wakes with the angel Akroma, whom he sends to eliminate Phage.
timeline.quote: He agrees, then sends her to eliminate Phage.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor's spark makes nightmares real; Phage expels deathwurms and is Jeska again.
timeline.quote: she is Jeska once again, and she exchanges a few tender words with her brother.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A deathwurm devours Ixidor after his unmen betray him.
timeline.quote: The wurm devours him.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Ixidor's Nightmare spell, Phage regurgitates beetles that become enormous deathwurms embodying her murders.
timeline.quote: These deathwurms were the embodiment of each of her murders.

citation.text: "Wurm", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor sends Akroma to fight the deathwurms but even the angel cannot stop them.
timeline.quote: Ixidor sent Akroma to battle them but not even the angel was able to stop them.

citation.text: "Wurm", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor flees with his unmen but some betray him and he is devoured.
timeline.quote: some of them betrayed him and he was devoured

citation.text: "Wurm", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma spreads Ixidor's message, effectively founding a religion around him.
timeline.quote: effectively founding a religion around him

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Queen of Topos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The wurm swallows Akroma; inside she finds Ixidor wishing to stay with Nivea's spirit and leaves him, her feet and wings eaten by acid.
timeline.quote: He wallowed in grief and wished to remain with the spirit of his dear Nivea.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Queen of Topos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The joint Cabal-Krosan army flees Phage's deathwurms at Topos; Akroma takes control of Topos after Ixidor is gone.
timeline.quote: Akroma takes control of Topos once she has learned that Ixidor is no longer.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Inside the deathwurm, Akroma finds Ixidor, who heals her and shows her the way out.
timeline.quote: He heals his creation, though, and shows her the way out.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona's presence destroys the Grand Coliseum as her worshippers tear its foundation apart.
timeline.quote: her very presence led to the destruction of the Grand Coliseum

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Armies converge on Sanctum; Akroma's forces are admitted by the Glyphs, which twist her soldiers' loyalty to Lowallyn.
timeline.quote: Akroma , leading the forces of Topos , was granted entrance to the city by the strange Glyph people

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl rescues Ixidor from the deathwurm; Ixidor reemerges as Lowallyn, the third numen.
timeline.quote: Ixador reemerges as Lowallyn, the third numen, who had given Ixidor his powers

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor creates six unmen as escape portals; during the fourth escape two unmen abandon him, leaving Umbra unclosed and Ixidor captured.
timeline.quote: two of the unmen decided they would very much like to not die and abandoned their creator

citation.text: "Sash and Waistcoat", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor and Nivea make a living betting on themselves in the Cabal pit fights in Aphetto.
timeline.quote: he partnered with his love Nivea to make their living betting on themselves in the Cabal pit fights

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Pit fighting in Aphetto". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage kills Nivea, and Ixidor loses his fame and fortune.
timeline.quote: Ixidor lost his fame and fortune after Nivea was killed by Phage

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Pit fighting in Aphetto". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor is banished to a desert for failing to pay his debts and discovers he can create real things.
timeline.quote: There, he discovered his powers to create real things instead of just illusions.

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor creates an army led by Akroma to wage war on the Cabal in revenge.
timeline.quote: He also created an army led by Akroma to wage war on the Cabal

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cabal attacks Ixidor's fortress and he is consumed by a deathwurm representing Nivea's death.
timeline.quote: Ixidor was consumed by a deathwurm representing Nivea's death

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma finds Ixidor living in the wurm, worshipping an image of Nivea; he restores Akroma but refuses to return.
timeline.quote: He restored Akroma but refused to come back to the real world.

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl kills the death wurm in Topos, freeing Ixidor and recruiting him against Karona.
timeline.quote: He found the death wurm in Topos and killed it, freeing Ixidor and recruiting him to his cause.

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor is possessed by Lowallyn, who is killed by Karona in the final battle, ending Ixidor's life too.
timeline.quote: Lowallyn was killed in the final battle by Karona, thus also ending the life of Ixidor.

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor, exiled to the desert of Otaria, gained Lowallyn's magic and raised Topos.
timeline.quote: He raised from the sands a paradise he named Topos

citation.text: "Nightmare War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor created Akroma to avenge Nivea against Phage.
timeline.quote: a single purpose: revenge against Phage

citation.text: "Nightmare War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A deathwurm born from Nivea's murder devoured Ixidor.
timeline.quote: it hunted down Ixidor

citation.text: "Nightmare War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Exiled Ixidor imagines an oasis and builds Topos, then Akroma is born from his dreams.
timeline.quote: The exiled Ixidor imagined the oasis out of a mirage in thirst and desperation.

citation.text: "Topos", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Nightmare War, attackers charge Topos to kill Akroma; Ixidor creates sprites that conjure nightmares.
timeline.quote: Ixidor stopped them by creating disciples, tiny light-sprites that could enter their opponents' minds and create their worst nightmares.

citation.text: "Topos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The prime death worm, representing Nivea's death, rampages through Topos, destroys much of Locus and consumes Ixidor.
timeline.quote: it locked onto Ixidor as its target, rampaging through Topos and destroying much of Locus before it caught up to the illusionist and consumed him.

citation.text: "Topos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After sending Phage to lead the Nightmare War, the First receives a vision from Kuberr that they belong together but she might kill him.
timeline.quote: he received a vision from Kuberr that they belonged together

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Lorwallyn was reincarnated as the illusionist Ixidor .

citation.text: "Lowallyn", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Akroma — still bound by Ixidor's final orders

citation.text: "Nightmare War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
